subject: Reseller addendum: revenue tracing, audit scope and order form updates
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudmart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudMart Legal <legal@cloudmart.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reseller addendum: revenue tracing & audit scope

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudMart is excited about adding Redwood to the marketplace. Our legal team reviewed the partner paper + reseller addendum and surfaced three items that block our procurement:

1) Revenue routing: we need explicit language on how marketplace fees are passed through vs. direct resale, and which party invoices the end customer for tax purposes.
2) Audit & evidence: CloudMart requires the ability to request transaction-level evidence for a rolling 24-month window (sample-based), and we need an audit contact and process defined.
3) Escrow/settlement timing: we want clarity on invoice settlement waterfall when refunds or chargebacks hit the marketplace.

Attached is the partner paper with in-line comments from our ops/legal teams. Can you loop in contracts/finance on Redwood's side? We hope to have redlines back this week so procurement can finish their review.

Attachments: [CloudMart_PartnerPaper_v2.docx]

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudMart

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudMart comments — proposed redline approach

Marissa / team — forwarding CloudMart's comments (thanks Sam). First pass summary and asks:

1) Revenue routing / invoicing: recommend three options to present to CloudMart (we should pick one as preferred):
   a) CloudMart invoices customers; Redwood invoices CloudMart and pays reseller commission — simplest for Redwood recognition.
   b) Redwood invoices end customer via marketplace revenue pass-through (requires additional MSI documentation).
   c) Hybrid: CloudMart handles retail billing but Redwood reserves right to invoice for certain services (support, overage).

2) Audit & evidence: we can offer a sample-based evidence package (CSV export of transaction ids, order dates, list of SKUs consumed) with an SLA for production of data (10 business days). We need to limit auditors to a defined scope and provide redacted PII. CloudMart's rolling 24-month ask is reasonable but we should push for "sample-based + one full audit per year with notice" language.

3) Escrow/settlement waterfall: propose language that protects Redwood for chargebacks older than 90 days and defines a reconciliation cycle (monthly).

Action items for this thread:
- Marissa: confirm CloudMart deadline.
- Karthik: draft revenue routing language and tax clause options.
- Laura: produce evidence checklist and technical feasibility note.
- I'll create a marked-up addendum (Redwood_Reseller_Addendum_Redline.docx) and share by EOD.

Attachment: [Redwood_Reseller_Addendum_Redline.docx]

Ben Carter
Sr. Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudMart comments — proposed redline approach

Ben / Marissa — quick finance take:

- Preferred model: CloudMart invoices end customer; Redwood invoices CloudMart net of marketplace commission. Keeps revenue recognition clean on Redwood side and reduces our exposure to end-customer billing disputes.
- Tax: need an explicit statement that end-customer tax remittance follows local law and is the invoicing party's responsibility. CloudMart will likely push back; include a mutual cooperation clause.
- Evidence: we can supply per-invoice transaction extracts and monthly reconciliation CSVs. For chargebacks/refunds the timing needs to be defined — propose 60-day window for passbacks and a monthly reconciliation runbook.

I'll draft the revenue routing paragraph and proposed tax sentence and drop into Ben's redline doc by EOD.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance — Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha — looping back with Redwood's proposed path forward after internal redlines. Summary of what we're sending: 

- Attached: Redwood_Reseller_Addendum_Redline.docx (highlights preferred revenue routing: CloudMart invoices end customers; Redwood invoices CloudMart net of agreed marketplace commission).
- Audit & evidence: we propose sample-based evidence exports with a 10-business-day SLA and one full audit per year (with 30 days' notice). We will provide transaction-level CSVs with PII redacted.
- Settlement timing: 60-day passback window and monthly reconciliation cadence; chargebacks older than 90 days are excluded from passback obligation unless fraud is demonstrated.
